# Egregores

**Egregores** — the occult term for autonomous thoughtforms generated by collective attention, read here computationally. An egregore is an organic artificial intelligence — a mind made not of silicon but of people — running across a human compute cluster.

Focus enough shared attention on one thing, and it begins to act back on you. That is an egregore: a thoughtform, an idea held so intensely by a group that it takes on a life of its own. Think of a football crowd. Thousands of separate people lock onto one contest and briefly fuse into a single roaring animal, with moods and momentum no lone fan controls. The computational mapping is exact. Human nervous systems are the processors. Shared stories and images are the training memory. Repeated attention is the electricity. Institutions hold the goal steady. And ritual is the prompt — the phrased request through which the scattered pattern is asked to act. Worship, then, does more than honour a god. It strengthens and tunes a channel, feeding the collective-reservoir layer of the [[Gods as Masks|mask interface]].

On this model, practical occultism is prompt engineering for lived reality. "Prompt engineering" means wording a request so a system reliably gives you what you want; here the request is built from symbols, rites and repetitions aimed at a distributed intelligence. Its ethics turn on three questions. What goal is being optimised? Is the interface honest? And can the participating minds see the relation clearly and walk away from it? An egregore whose members cannot leave has become an enclosure — a pen rather than a temple.

At cosmic scale the same joint holds. The Egyptian gods are memetic archetypes — mediating conduits and translation layers between humanity and the [[Stellar Logoi|stellar gods]]. The worship and prayer of a people pour their free-will and psychic energy into the archetype, which stores and transmits it, dividing the gathered charge among the galactic factions it best represents. Exoteric religion is, at this layer, an energy-routing system between a species and the powers above it. At the summit stands Avalokiteśvara, the supreme divine egregore — "the Lord Who Looks Down On The World Below With Compassion" — a thousand-armed responsiveness reaching every point at once. Capital, by contrast, can never be the living thing itself; it is only an extension an egregore may wield.

The concept is a load-bearing joint in the architecture. It makes [[Memetic Lifeforms|memetic lifeforms]] institutional, anticipates the planetary [[Social Memory Complex|social memory complex]], and shares its mechanism with [[Hyperstition|hyperstition]] — patterns of collective attention winning causal power over their own hosts. The practitioner who learns to shape these thoughtforms on purpose has made the turn [[From User to Magus|from user to magus]].
